interpretation: Six saved-output comparisons each recorded exact zero error on the same two clips. This does not validate unsaved requests, full numerical isolation or quality.
All copied benchmark numerical and headline flags remain false. These are one-warmup development screens; every completed throughput trial contains four requests.

Prefetch request latency begins at input loading and includes waiting for serial execution. Queue-inclusive medians near115seconds coexist with generation near57seconds and wall throughput near0.0174futures/second.
Use completed futures divided by measured wall time for pipeline throughput. Summing queue-inclusive request latencies double-counts overlapping waits.
Uncached means a fresh engine context; it does not guarantee a cold operating-system page cache. Warm-filesystem explicitly reads observed files before warmup.

Fresh-context conditioning-cache correctness requests spent about1.36seconds in prepare_context and about55.39seconds in generate_wall; intra-request hits do not establish cross-request reuse or a throughput gain.
No p95, confidence interval, speedup ranking or generalization is reported from these short trials.
Only immutable metadata was copied. Its hashes and all producer source hashes were revalidated locally; exact-output results are recorded producer evidence, not a fresh local array comparison.
